#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check if addon.py and bundled/addon.py are identical. Report first difference."""
import sys

root = open("addon.py", "r", encoding="utf-8")
bundled = open("src/blender_mcp/bundled/addon.py", "r", encoding="utf-8")

root_lines = root.readlines()
bundled_lines = bundled.readlines()

if root_lines == bundled_lines:
    print("IDENTICAL")
    sys.exit(0)

print(f"root has {len(root_lines)} lines, bundled has {len(bundled_lines)} lines")

min_len = min(len(root_lines), len(bundled_lines))
for i in range(min_len):
    if root_lines[i] != bundled_lines[i]:
        print(f"FIRST DIFFERENCE at line {i+1}:")
        print(f"  ROOT:     {root_lines[i].rstrip()!r}")
        print(f"  BUNDLED:  {bundled_lines[i].rstrip()!r}")
        break

else:
    if len(root_lines) != len(bundled_lines):
        extra = len(root_lines) - len(bundled_lines)
        direction = "extra in ROOT" if extra > 0 else "extra in BUNDLED"
        print(f"DIFFER in length: {abs(extra)} lines {direction}")

sys.exit(1)
